world_cup.title: Emotional Gakpo scores days after loss of unborn son
world_cup.summary: Liverpool forward Cody Gakpo scores for the Netherlands days after the loss of his unborn son, as they are knocked out on penalties by Morocco.

world_cup.title: 45 minutes from Brazil 'humiliation' - but 'Crafty Carlo' does it again
world_cup.summary: Half-time in Houston and Brazil's players trudged off facing another early World Cup exit. But we should have known better than to doubt Carlo Ancelotti.

world_cup.title: Paraguay's tears of joy over World Cup shock
world_cup.summary: How Paraguay marked one of the biggest wins in their footballing history with euphoric celebrations.
